label: Broadband speed (average download)
definition: Sum of the maximum advertised downstream speed (Max CIR) of all providers across block groups in the tract, divided by the number of provider-block-group pairs. Source: FCC Form 477 Broadband Deployment Data.
notes_limitations: Advertised maximum speeds, not measured speeds. Includes DSL/cable and satellite providers. Providers reporting zero ('best effort') were dropped by NaNDA. UNITS: documentation says kbps but values (e.g., ~8.5 in 2014) look like Mbps, the unit FCC Form 477 uses -- confirm before reporting. Tracts with no provider in any year are absent. 2010 tract vintage.

label: Broadband adoption (connections per 1000 households; 10 Mbps down / 1 Mbps up)
definition: Residential fixed internet connections of at least 10 Mbps down and 1 Mbps up per 1,000 households, from FCC residential fixed connection maps. Categorical code: 0 = zero; 1 = 1-200; 2 = 201-400; 3 = 401-600; 4 = 601-800; 5 = more than 800.
notes_limitations: ORDINAL CATEGORY, not a continuous rate; treat accordingly in analysis. Real data only for 2015-2018: NaNDA copied 2015 values into 2014, and 2019-2020 are missing (about 29% missing nationally). 2010 tract vintage.

label: Vocational schools per 1000 residents
definition: Count of vocational schools (SIC 8249xxxx: specialized vocational courses) in the tract per 1,000 population. Establishments from NETS (Dun & Bradstreet); population from ACS.
notes_limitations: Set to missing by NaNDA when tract population is zero. NETS establishment data have known coverage/accuracy limits; NaNDA re-geocoded and removed businesses at residential parcels. Data end in 2022.

label: Business and secretarial schools per 1000 residents
definition: Count of business and secretarial schools (SIC 8244xxxx) in the tract per 1,000 population.
notes_limitations: See vocational schools note. Data end in 2022.

label: Data processing schools per 1000 residents
definition: Count of data processing / computer training schools (SIC 8243xxxx) in the tract per 1,000 population.
notes_limitations: See vocational schools note. Data end in 2022.

label: Educational services per 1000 residents
definition: Count of educational services establishments (SIC 8299xxxx general: music/drama/language schools, exam prep, vocational counseling, etc.) per 1,000 population.
notes_limitations: See vocational schools note. Data end in 2022.

label: Beauty schools and barber colleges per 1000 residents
definition: Count of beauty, barber, and cosmetology schools (SIC 7231020x, 72419901) per 1,000 population.
notes_limitations: See vocational schools note. Data end in 2022.

label: Instruction schools, camps, and services per 1000 residents
definition: Count of recreational skills instruction and day camp establishments (SIC 799911xx) per 1,000 population.
notes_limitations: See vocational schools note. Data end in 2022.

label: Reading and speaking schools per 1000 residents
definition: Count of reading, speaking, language, and diction schools (SIC 829905xx) per 1,000 population.
notes_limitations: See vocational schools note. Data end in 2022.

label: Personal development schools per 1000 residents
definition: Count of personal development schools (SIC 829999xx) per 1,000 population. The workplan calls these 'professional development schools'; NaNDA's category name is 'Personal Development Schools'.
notes_limitations: See vocational schools note. Data end in 2022. Confirm with Deena that this is the intended category.
